# Subsystem Modeling

> An open-source project for verifiable system diagrams: Subsystem Models that agents and humans can check against real code, not disposable sketches.

Subsystem Models describe one slice of a codebase as named components (anchored to real symbols), typed edges, and optional execution flows (throughlines). The goal is a mental model you can refine and verify against the code.

## Get started

To make your first Subsystem Model, install the agent skill:

- [create-subsystem-model](https://skills.sh/principal-ai/subsystem-modeling/create-subsystem-model): Agent skill that authors a model and creates it with `npx -y @principal-ai/principal-studio-cli subsystem-model create`, then opens it in Subsystems Studio.

Example prompt after installing the skill:

> Diagram the checkout subsystem in this repo as a Subsystem Model, then open it in Subsystems Studio.
